title: Brand
subtitle: What your partners and clients see when they open the workspace: the name, the logo, the colour, the domain.
restricted: Only the workspace owner and admins can change the brand — it changes what EVERYONE sees.

identity.title: Identity
identity.description: The name replaces “{{brand}}” everywhere: header, tab title, exported dossiers, public share page.
identity.logoHelp: A public address served over HTTPS. A square that stays legible at 24 px.
identity.logoInvalid: A full HTTPS address is expected.
identity.accentHelp: It repaints buttons, the active tab and the focus ring. It touches neither backgrounds nor text.
identity.accentInvalid: A six-digit hex code is expected, for example #5b3ee8.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Point a subdomain of your own at the app. That is what keeps a partner from ever reading our name in their address bar.
domain.label: Custom domain
domain.help: No https://, no port. A CNAME record pointing at our domain still has to be added at your host.
domain.invalid: A domain name is expected, for example app.yourcompany.com.
domain.taken: That domain is already used by another workspace.
domain.emailHelp: The sender of emails this workspace sends. The domain must be authenticated on your side (SPF, DKIM), or messages land in spam.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: What the header carries with the current settings.

actions.resetConfirm: Clear the name, logo, colour, domain and sending address?

loadFailed: The brand could not be read.
demoBlocked: The brand cannot be changed in the demo room — it is shared by every visitor.

documents.title: Document identity
documents.description: What your workspace adds to its skills files: a signature at the end of the document and a footer at the bottom of each page.
documents.signatureHelp: Placed at the end of the document. One line per item (team, phone, email).
documents.footerHelp: Repeated at the bottom of every page — company name, confidentiality notice.
documents.previewLabel: Preview of a skills file with the workspace signature and footer
